messages:
Ash: Okay team @here — hypothetical quick one: if your desk got swapped out for any vehicle for a week, which would you pick? One-line answers please :grin:
Maria: Folding café scooter — can scoot to the kitchen and wheel under Zoom calls. Compact, caffeinated, 10/10. :coffee: :scooter:
TJ: Old VW camper. Big tabletop, tiny fridge, built-in nap zone. Perfect for all-day deep work. :van: 
Sophie: A tiny sailing dinghy. Fresh breeze, ambient waves, very poetic. Also I might be seasick. :boat:
Lee: Stationary treadmill desk but disguised as a bulldozer so I feel powerful during standups. :bulldozer: :sweat_smile:
Noah: Retro arcade cabinet. Buttons on the desk. Productivity will tank but morale skyrockets. :video_game:
m-labs-bot: Poll created — react with :one: for scooter, :two: camper, :three: dinghy, :four: bulldozer, :five: arcade
Ash: Bonus points for funniest use-case. Sophie you're already winning for vibe. :laughing:
Maria: Also the scooter has a secret under-desk heater. Serious winter MVP. :fire:
TJ: @Maria trade you camper nap privileges for that heater. Deal? :handshake:
Lee: Voting :four:, but secretly want an excavator to dig for lost meeting notes. :nerd_face:
Sophie: Can we also have a mandatory desk-pet rule? Dinghy gets a rubber duck. :duck:
Noah: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/vibes-office-3o6gbbuLW76jkt8vIc — "we need the vibes"
Ash: Alright results so far — :two: is leading. We'll let the poll run until EOD. Thanks for the chaos, folks :tada:
Maria: If the camper wins I'm bringing tiny string lights. It becomes the clubhouse. :love_you_gesture:
